notes.title: Global Soccer: A Management Game 2018 will become free next Friday!
notes.notes:
Dear Players!

I've came to the decision to change "Global Soccer: A Management Game 2018" from paid to free to play.
If you're not familiar with this game, this is a simplistic, retro-style football manager game, which aims to bring back good memories from the old CM2 times.
The change will take place on April 12, so if you were to buy the game, then please don't do it.
If you'd still like to try out this series before this date, or you'd like to support me, you can still buy GSM 2017 or GSM 2019.
The change is permanent, so GSM 2018 will remain free forever.
Also, please don't forget to wishlist my upcoming games, a comedy visual novel called "Singles' Generation" and a turn-based fantasy RPG called "Tales Of Chandar".

Here are the Steam store pages of the above mentioned games:

Global Soccer: A Management Game 2017:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/625700/Global_Soccer_A_Management_Game_2017/
Global Soccer: A Management Game 2018:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/808420/Global_Soccer_A_Management_Game_2018/
Global Soccer: A Management Game 2019:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052550/Global_Soccer_A_Management_Game_2019/
Singles' Generation:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1531590/Singles_Generation/
Tales of Chandar:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1365780/Tales_Of_Chandar/

Hope you'll have a good time with the game!
With best regards,
Mark

notes.title: Global Soccer Manager 2019 is coming!
notes.notes:
Dear Players!

The Global Soccer Manager series continues: the new episode brings the new season (18/19).
If you haven't seen it yet, the Steam store page of the new game is already available. Check out the new trailer and the screenshots:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052550/Global_Soccer_Manager_2019/

Be sure to follow my new Facebook page for more informations about my upcoming games:

Thanks for all the support! See you soon!

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Dear Players!

I have updated the game based on your reactions/comments/suggestions. I hope you'll like the new functions!

-On the league table now you'll see which clubs will play in next season's continental cups.
-On the tactics screen now you can swap players by clicking on their faces. This makes things quicker, because you don't have to click back to the Squad screen to swap your AML to FLC for example.
-Date format can be changed in the Settings menu from YYYY.MM.DD to DD.MM.YYYY or to MM.DD.YYYY.
-If the bright news background is hurting your eyes, you can change it to a darker one. Just visit the Settings menu.

Thanks for all the feedbacks!

notes.title: First bugfix, please read it
notes.notes:
Dear players!

If you tried to play in the "Classic matches" mode and right after you've started a new game, the starting date was set to a wrong one (26th May instead of 1st July).
This led to a boring/uneventful June (and to an incorrect Player of the year selection), but I guess no bigger harms were done.
The bug is now fixed, and sorry for the inconvenience.
Please keep reporting bugs you'll may find, thank you.
